fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: The Boiler Upgrade Scheme is the UK government's flagship grant for replacing fossil fuel heating. As an MCS-certified installer, GW Renewables can support your BUS grant application, helping you access funding to reduce your installation cost.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Available for qualifying Air Source Heat Pump installations in England & Wales. Subject to eligibility. Ask us at your free survey.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: GW Renewables focuses on the technology best suited to the South West: Air Source Heat Pumps, designed and installed by MCS-certified engineers with full manufacturer warranty.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Annual servicing plans · Fault diagnosis & repair · Performance optimisation for existing systems

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: A straightforward four-step journey from your first call to a fully commissioned, grant-funded heat pump.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: We visit your property, assess compatibility, and design the right system specification at no cost.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Clear, all-in quote with the £7,500 BUS grant already deducted. No surprises, no hidden extras.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Most homes are completed in 2–4 days by our MCS-certified engineers with minimal disruption.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Full commissioning, MCS certificate, system walkthrough, and optional annual service plan.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Fully certified under the Microgeneration Certification Scheme, mandatory for BUS grant eligibility.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: As MCS-certified installers we can support your BUS grant application. Grant funding is applied directly to your installation cost.

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Most homes are suitable, including older properties. Key factors are available outdoor space for the unit, reasonable insulation, and a compatible heat distribution system (radiators or underfloor heating). Our free survey assesses your property and recommends the right specification.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Installed costs typically range from £8,000 to £15,000 depending on property size and specification. With the £7,500 BUS grant deducted, your net investment is significantly lower. We provide fixed, transparent quotes after every survey.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: In many cases, yes. Modern heat pumps operate at higher flow temperatures than older models and work well with existing radiators. Some oversizing may be needed in colder rooms. We assess this during the free survey and include any upgrades in the quote.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: The BUS is a UK government grant of £7,500 towards qualifying heat pump installations. As a BUS-approved installer, we apply on your behalf. The grant is simply deducted from your total cost. You don't need to fill in any forms yourself.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: Most residential installations take 2 to 4 days. Properties requiring radiator upgrades may take a little longer. We give a clear timeline as part of the quote process.
